name: Baked & Blended
notes: All 4 photos are the same two illuminated menu boards (donuts/soft-serve/churros) photographed from different distances and angles; merged into one item set, using the closer/clearer shots to fill in text partly obscured by glare in others. Belmont Park Water Bottle included as a listed menu item; the Donut Madness item's price was illegible behind glare and omitted.

dishes.name: Classic Donuts
dishes.description: Traditional Glaze, Cinnamon Sugar, or Plain; served with choice of chocolate or caramel sauce. Half dozen $8.

dishes.name: Loaded Donuts
dishes.description: Half dozen. Beachside Smores, Cinnamon Toast Crunch, Fruity Pebble Madness, Cocoa Pebble Craze, or Oreo Cookie Crunch.

dishes.name: Donut Madness
dishes.description: Two dozen donuts topped with Vanilla and Chocolate Soft Serve, Whipped Cream, Caramel Sauce, Chocolate Sauce, Cocoa Pebbles, Fruity Pebbles, Peanuts, Sprinkles and Cherries. Serves 2-4 people.

dishes.name: Soft Serve

dishes.name: Loaded Milkshakes
dishes.description: 16 oz, served with two donuts on straw. Oreo Crunch, Churro Toast Crunch, Beach Smores, Cocoa Pebble Craze, Fruity Pebble Madness.

dishes.name: Stuffed Churro
dishes.description: Full-size churro stuffed with choice of Caramel or Chocolate Sauce.

dishes.name: Churro Bites
dishes.description: Bowl of mini-churros served with choice of Chocolate or Caramel Sauce.

dishes.name: Churro Bites Beach Box
dishes.description: One pound of mini-churros tossed in Cinnamon Sugar and topped with Vanilla Soft Serve, Chocolate Sauce and Caramel Sauce. Serves 2-4 people.
